chapter_title_en: The Edict to Slay Xiao Chen
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch331: Kill Chen Order – Yizhen's Sacrifice
chapter_meta_description: Half-ancestors issue the Kill Chen Order, slaughter innocent villages, and capture Su Ying. Xiao Chen rushes to save Yizhen but arrives to witness his enlightened death and vow for vengeance.
og_title: Kill Chen Order: A Saint Falls in Songshan
og_description: Half-ancestors issue a world-wide execution order against Xiao Chen. Yizhen sacrifices himself against six prodigies, leaving a sarira. Xiao Chen vows bloody revenge.
